queries.title: Search terms
queries.description: One Vinted search per term, e.g. nike jacket, levis 501, adidas samba, zara dress.

country.title: Vinted site
country.description: Which country's Vinted to search for the search terms. Prices come in that site's currency.

searchUrls.title: Or Vinted catalog URLs
searchUrls.description: Catalog pages copied from any Vinted site with your filters set (brand, size, condition, colour, category, price), e.g. vinted.fr/catalog?search_text=...&brand_ids[]=53.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of results for search terms. Newest first on a schedule collects new listings.

includeDetails.title: Description and seller
includeDetails.description: Reads each item page for the full description, category, colour, material, upload time and the seller's name, review count and rating. Costs $0.002 per item instead of $0.0008.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max items per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Stop each search after this many items. Vinted shows 960 per search; bigger searches are split by price automatically.
